TMC ACTREC Lab Technician Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for TMC ACTREC Lab Technician Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the TMC ACTREC recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Lab Technician. This is a contract-based position at the Advanced Centre for Treatment Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC).

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Lab Technician post. The recruitment is being conducted through a walk-in interview process.

faq.question: Q3. What are the educational qualifications required for the Lab Technician role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc. (MLT) or B.Sc with D.M.L.T from a recognized university or State Board of Technical Education. Practical experience is also mandatory.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any experience required for the Lab Technician position?
faq.answer: Yes, independent working experience as a technician in a Surgical Pathology Lab or Cytopathology Lab dealing with diagnostic samples is mandatory for this role.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Lab Technician post is 35 years. Age relaxation may be considered based on experience.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Lab Technician position?
faq.answer: The salary for the Lab Technician position ranges from Rs. 26,210/- to Rs. 35,000/- per month, depending on qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for the TMC ACTREC Lab Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. How can candidates apply for the Lab Technician position?
faq.answer: Candidates need to attend a walk-in interview with all required original documents and self-attested copies at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Lab Technician recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. When and where is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled for 23 September 2026 at the TMC ACTREC office in Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra.
